learning_outcomes.text: solve systems of linear equations and understand the structure of the solutions
work with scalar and vector products of geometric vectors
carry out calculations with matrices and determinants
understand the concept of vector space, and calculate with vectors and coordinates
determine and work with orthonormal bases in Euclidean spaces, apply the 'least-squares' method and use these to calculate the orthogonal projection on a subspace
understand the concept of linear transformations, find its matrix and calculate kernel and range
identify and work with symmetric and isometric linear transformations
determine eigenvectors and eigenvalues, and interpret them geometrically
understand and apply the principle axes theorem
understand and use quadratic forms in geometric applications
work through simple applications to linear differential equations and difference equations

syllabus_topics: Geometric vectors, straight lines and planes in three dimensions
General vector spaces and Euclidean spaces
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors, diagonalisation of matrices, linear transformations, quadratic forms
Elementary applications to linear differential equations and difference equations
assessment_rules: The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5. To pass the course, students need to pass both KTR1 and TEN1. TEN1 is graded on a scale of U, 3, 4, 5, while KTR1 is graded U, G.
bibliography: Janfalk, U, Exempelsamling till Janfalk, Ulf: Linjär algebra
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
